worldcombat.skill.shellsidearm.summary: Press a venomous shell into the firing chamber and launch it. At release it reads the shot: if the target is at point-blank and the ram hits harder, it swings the arm out for a blunt smash (physical, contact), otherwise it sprays venom (special, non-contact). A hit may poison. You can pin it to the ram (harder, but only at point-blank) or the spray (longer and steadier).
worldcombat.skill.shellsidearm.descripti: On hit the target takes one blow of about %1$s damage, and physical or special is fixed at release: in auto form, within melee reach it compares attack/special defence to pick the harder side, and at range or with no target it always sprays. The blow grows from whichever of attack and special attack is higher. The attack/special gap %2$s shows whether the individual leans to ram or spray.

Spray range %1$s, melee ram reach %2$s (capped at 3 blocks plus the body boundary), shell speed %3$s, hit radius %4$s; the ram is a real first-contact short swing, while the spray homes in on its locked target.
On hit there is a %1$s chance to poison the target for %2$s; a poisoned target loses health over time, and Poison- and Steel-types are immune.
worldcombat.skill.shellsidearm.form.auto: Auto: reads the actual distance - within melee reach it compares attack/special defence to pick ram or spray, at range it can only spray; with no target it defaults to spray, and you can still manually smash empty air.
worldcombat.skill.shellsidearm.form.ram: Ram: swing the arm for a point-blank smash, forced physical and contact, power x1.05, but it only reaches 3 blocks, shell speed x0.85, +2 windup and +4 cooldown - harder, and only at point-blank.
worldcombat.skill.shellsidearm.form.spra: Spray: forced special and non-contact, range x1.15 and shell speed x1.15, but power x0.95 - longer and steadier for a little less damage.
worldcombat.skill.shellsidearm.timing: Range %1$s, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.shellsidearm.growth.0: From level %1$s the shell power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.shellsidearm.growth.1: From level %1$s the shell power is %2$s and poison lasts %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.shellsidearm.use.0: Hit an unknown soft side for the most damage
worldcombat.skill.shellsidearm.use.1: A heavy venom shell from long range
worldcombat.skill.shellsidearm.use.2: Switch to the ram for a point-blank burst
worldcombat.skill.shellsidearm.preferenc: Auto reads distance at release: within melee reach it compares attack/special defence to pick ram or spray, at range only spray, and with no target it sprays; ram swings the arm for forced physical contact at x1.05 power but only reaches 3 blocks and is slower and longer; spray forces special non-contact with more range and speed at x0.95 power.
Only within this distance does it consider the target for a shell, then shared approach logic brings the body into range; a larger value starts looking for a position sooner.
When on, low-health targets rank higher so the heavy shell finishes them; when off, all targets rank the same.
When on, targets beyond sixty percent of the range rank higher so the shell is fired from a safer distance; when off, distance does not matter and it is happy to close in.
When on, the companion may leave its post to find a firing position; when off, it only casts at what it can reach from where it stands.
world_combat.move.shellsidearm.text.immu: The foe shrugged off the shell
